name: The Aurochs Problem
summary: Drive the aurochs off the southern fields.
startText: A herd of aurochs has taken the southern fields and gored two farmhands. Put down three and the rest will move on. Mind the bramblecaps on the way.
inProgressText: Three meadow aurochs, in the south-east of the fields.
completionText: That will hold them. Take these boots; you have walked far enough in the old ones.
